run_bm_focal_loss: run the bm_focal_loss benchmark to measure focal loss performance across different input sizes on CUDA
run_bm_focal_loss_star: run the bm_focal_loss_star benchmark to measure focal loss star variant performance on CUDA
benchmark_focal_loss_jit: benchmark the JIT-compiled focal loss implementation against the standard version using fvcore benchmark
benchmark_focal_loss_with_alpha: benchmark focal loss computation with and without alpha weighting across batch sizes 100 to 10000
review_bm_focal_loss: review the bm_focal_loss and bm_focal_loss_star benchmark functions for CUDA availability checks and test configurations
